note: Time series 2000-2023. v1 = 2023-calibrated intensities x each year’s activity (intermediate years interpolated between 2000/2010/2023 benchmarks). v2 re-calibration then rescales each material’s LEVEL to the real world-consumption trend (USGS/IEA), anchored so 2023 = the calibrated value. Shows activity-driven distribution + real level trend; does NOT model thrifting/substitution. Broad-driver materials only.
